job.title: Life Insurance Specialist
job.description:
Shape how insurance advice evolves while building your income without artificial caps. You’ll work from anywhere, choosing between home or office, and benefit from paid parental leave and strong referral leads that take the pressure off sourcing your own clients.

Your commercial success will be backed by warm referrals from trusted networks, not cold digital leads. This means better client engagement and smoother conversations, giving you the chance to convert high-quality opportunities into completed policies.

With broader insurer options and a supportive team led by someone with hands-on life insurance experience, you’ll have the tools and guidance to maximise your performance. The incentive structure is designed to reward you fairly, without arbitrary limits on your earnings.

What you’ll do

Convert referred opportunities into completed life insurance policies, while ensuring clients receive clear, balanced General Advice and enough education to make informed decisions without feeling rushed or pressured.

You'll conduct outbound General Advice conversations with referred clients, explaining insurance types, product differences, and underwriting considerations. You'll provide quotes, map out next steps, and assist clients in completing applications, including medical questionnaires where required.

Manage cases through underwriting, medical requirements, and suspense, following up proactively to keep cases progressing. You'll maintain accurate advice and client records and operate within General Advice and internal compliance requirements.

What you’ll need

  • Strong sales drive and motivation to achieve commercial targets.
  • Excellent communication skills and pipeline management.
  • Ability to work autonomously and protect long-term relationships.

About the company

The organisation are specialists in protection. They prioritise customers over profits. They offer cover through personal, business, and employee benefits channels, ensuring customers are looked after and that they have the right cover.

If this is a role of interest, please click the ‘Apply’ button.

job.title: Practice Development Manager
job.description:
Take the lead in a role where you can genuinely shape how a growing advice network performs, develops, and scales.

You’ll step into a Practice Development role with the opportunity to lead a growing team, influence strategy, and build the frameworks that help practices perform at their best.

Rather than inheriting a finished model, you’ll have the freedom to shape how Practice Development works. You’ll lead a team of Practice Development Associates, create a more proactive portfolio approach, and help practices improve productivity, revenue, engagement, and execution.

You’ll also have the opportunity to grow as a leader. Around half of the role is focused on people, giving you the chance to coach, develop and set direction for a team that will grow as the network expands.

This is not a traditional new-business acquisition role. It is about helping existing practices become stronger, more productive businesses, and building the operating model that supports them.

You’ll have direct access to senior leadership, visible commercial impact, and genuine scope to influence how the function evolves. If you enjoy building, coaching, solving problems, and seeing a direct connection between your work and business performance, this is a role where you can make your mark.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience within Australian life insurance, advice, or a licensee environment
    • A track record of leading, coaching, or developing people
    • Experience helping advisers, practices or partners improve business performance
    • Strong relationship and influencing skills
    • The ability to create structure, drive accountability, and bring people on the journey

Experience in practice development, advice management, practice management, adviser enablement, sales leadership, or strategic account management would all be highly relevant.

Why this could be a great next move for you

You’ll be joining a fast-growing business operating in one of the most dynamic areas of the Australian life insurance market.

The network is continuing to grow, giving you the chance to lead at meaningful scale while still having the freedom to shape how things are done.

You’ll work in an open, collaborative environment with direct access to senior leadership and the opportunity to contribute beyond the confines of a traditional job description.

Most importantly, this is a role where your impact will be visible. You’ll be able to see how better leadership, stronger practice support, and smarter commercial focus translate into better outcomes across the network.

For the right person, it’s an opportunity to build something, lead people, broaden your influence, and grow with the business.

If this is a role that appeals, please Apply Now

job.title: Life Claims - Senior Case Managers / Case Managers
job.description:
Our client is a global life insurance business, which has a long-standing presence and strong reputation in the Australian market. The business already has a large and established claims function (and support functions) and these new roles are designed to support the business, existing team and future growth.

Roles and Information:



  • Case Manager and Senior Case Managers
  • Group and Retail Teams
  • Salary range of $105K - $135K Package + Bonus
  • Hybrid working arrangements (2 or 3 days working from home)
  • Strong team culture and onboarding
  • Newly created roles across corporate & industry funds to choose from
  • Employee incentive plan and discounted insurance


Responsibilties/ Tasks:




  • Manage a portfolio of retail or group claims
  • Senior Case Managers manage a smaller portfolio of more complex and detailed claims
  • Work with empathy and understanding with claimants
  • Conduct file reviews on assessed claims for payment approvals
  • For Seniors, coach and mentor more junior claims consultants


If you have ife insurance claims experience (or potentially WC or Rehab) and want a change and to work for a growing business, then there are multiple roles. You will join teams with experienced and capable managers, and have the full support of a well-planned training and onboarding function. It's a time many are joining so you will be far from the only new starter.

If you are interested in new opportunities in life claims, please reach out to John Molony (john@bkcon.com.au).
